The '''Argoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argoon]].<ref name="TF" />

The system was [[Mission at Argoon|involved]] in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle on the Frontier|campaign]] led by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to secure the outer systems from [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] threats.<ref name="TF" />
